name: Translate to Malay
description: A voice speaks what you say in Malay. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 132 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Malay model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice id_ID-news_tts-medium (an Indonesian voice: Malay is read the same way) from rhasspy/piper-voices, see its model card.
